detail.longDescription:
Connect with friends across the Epic Ecosystem, with secure sign-in wherever you play. The Epic Games app brings your conversations together with cross-platform text and voice chat, and includes Epic Authenticator for fast, secure login on any device. Note: You can't access the Epic Games Store using this app.

Epic Parties and Voice Chat

• Start a party and jump into voice with friends across Fortnite, the Epic Games Launcher, and mobile
• Voice keeps running in the background when you minimize the app
• Organize your group chats and start voice calls directly from the group 

Cross-Platform Text Chat
• Send DMs across mobile, PC, and Fortnite
• Create group chats with up to 16 members
• Turn on notifications to get alerts for new messages
• View your last 30 days of chat history across devices
• Your conversations follow your Epic account everywhere you sign in

Secure Sign-In with Epic Authenticator
• Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for secure login
• Verify your identity quickly when you log into your Epic account on any device
• Keep your Fortnite account, progress, and purchases safe
• Use sign-in codes or one-tap verification to access your Epic account

One Connected Epic Ecosystem

Your Epic account links your games, devices, friends, and conversations into one social layer that moves with you. Start a party, chat with friends, plan your next match, and stay connected across mobile, PC, and Fortnite.

Sign in to get started.
